text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With every leap he makes,
gasps of admiration rise from the audience.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dazzling expressiveness and impeccable technique.
Her brilliance alone completely captivates the audience. That very figure is—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Truly the star of the show...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day my journey with Win Variation to take on the Twinkle Series began.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At her request, we were watching a DVD of a performance
by her father, who is a famous ballet dancer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A raw power far beyond imagination,
and a dazzling, blinding brilliance.
That radiant glare refused to fade from my mind—
choice_data_list: (So this is the leading role she's aiming for...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to bother you on such an important day.
Um, before today truly gets underway,
I wanted to show you the kind of lead role I'm aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
A beautiful, brilliant existence.
That is the true protagonist... my dad!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "...I wanna be the main character in the racing world."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Basking in the endless applause and cheers under the lights...
To become the most beautiful and radiant presence of all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, I gotta win.
'Cause in racing, the winner is the star of the show."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I wanna work hard!
I'm still not good enough, but if I work hard, my dream will definitely come true one day!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Because we can overcome any wall in our way...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do our best together!
Yeah, let's give it our all together!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Hehe, yes!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, I feel like I can win right now!
Like I could blow right past her without breaking a sweat!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's a bit early, but I'll head on ahead.
I've gotta make sure to warm up properly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Yes, in preparation for the upcoming Twinkle Series—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To build up some momentum,
we had scheduled an entry into a mock race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I headed to the track... for some reason, a sizable crowd of reporters seemed to be waiting with bated breath for the race to begin.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
This big of a crowd for a pre-debut mock race...?
Wait, normally—
choice_data_list: Yeah, you don't see this sort of thing often.
Yeah, you rarely see things go this far.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“I see...
Then just as I thought, this must be—”

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Orfevre's here!
Whoa, she really has quite the presence...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I had heard the rumors, but this exceeds my expectations.
It's hard to believe you haven't even debuted yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just by being there, she steals everyone's gaze.
An Umamusume radiating a breathtakingly dazzling aura—
Orfevre."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She is also the opponent Win Variation wants to defeat no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with a distinct feeling of being on away turf,
the mock race got underway—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah--!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was truly Orfevre's stage alone.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Around the final turn, Orfevre makes a move from the outside—
and takes the lead!
Orfevre is in front! Orfevre leads!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah, this pressure, as expected...!
It's buzzing, glaring, hot, and painful...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*!
...*gasp*, AAAAAAAAH!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation is coming right from behind!
But Orfevre pulls ahead by two lengths, three lengths!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweeping around the outside on the final straight to seize the lead, she broke away into a solo run.
Tearing down the turf like a blazing wind—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Damn it, wait, wait... I told you to wait...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...Gh!! Dammiiiit!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Orfevre crosses the finish line in a crushing victory!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... haa... gh!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Aaaargh! I couldn't even touch her shadow...!
Damn it, "feel like I can win" my foot!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Damn it, damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —O-Orfevre...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, ah... Wh-What...mini-!?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ignored!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Orfevre-san! Look over here, please!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, do you have a moment for an interview over here?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Just ignore me, huh... After all, who am I anyway...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the mock race, Win Variation
left the grounds without saying much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A brilliant start dash and a powerful burst down the final straight. Despite having just put on a run brimming with such promise—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Concerned by how she hurried off as if running away, I followed her...
and found her standing all alone on a deserted hill.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Gasp...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre, you...!!
YOU HUGE IDIOOOOOT!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Don't you dare ignore meeee! Look this way for once, you smug jerk!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Everything...! You took everything away from me!
The victory, the reporters, every single thing...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I had my eyes set only on you!
Dammit allーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It pisses me off...! So much, so much!
Dammit—someday, someday I will, absolutely!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna drag you down
from that throoooone!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Tr-Trainer!?
Wh-Wh-When did you get here...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Worried about how she was doing after the mock race,
I confessed that I had followed her.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... So that's what happened.
I'm the one who should apologize for making you worry.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Actually... um, I do this here every now and then.
O-Of course, only when nobody's around, though!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...It really does clear my head after all.
Helps me sort things out and motivates me to do my best."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back when I first met her,
she was suppressing dark emotions
like jealousy and envy toward Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Instead of repressing it, let's turn it into strength.
Passing on those words seems to have successfully empowered her—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: The leading star is... MEEEEEE!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "She has admirably mastered the art of sublimating her dark emotions."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Frustrated, irritated, and everything else.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I still get confused sometimes.
Wondering if it's really okay for me to feel this way.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
But, I've stopped hiding it.
'Cause I realized I can use these feelings as a springboard.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I want to surpass her. Whenever I think that, I feel like I can do anything...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation is diligent.
She trains meticulously,
and is cautious around othersâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I end up facing every single one of my emotions
far too earnestly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why she pushes herself so hard,
sometimes to a perilous degree.
choice_data_list: (As their Trainer, I have to properly support them.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"First, what I can do is—take a step forward.
Facing the cityscape sprawling below,
I took a deep breath."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: T-T-Trainer-san!?
choice_data_list: You can definitely become the star—!!
You will definitely become the star of the show!!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
choice_data_list: So let's give it our all together!
So let's give it our all together!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah.........
Wh... What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That was so sudden—you startled me.
Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Aha, ahahaha...! 
Ehehe. Sorry, that totally cracked me up...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Hehe.
...Yeah. Let's do our best, together...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, our days of sprinting through the Twinkle Series alongside Win Variation began.
